title: Register for primary and interchangeable knee arthroplasty
summary:
The aim of this registry study is to collect data on the healing process, the subjective sensation of pain and function and the so-called implant survival, i.e. how long the respective implants remain in the patient until removal is necessary. 
The background is a comprehensive collection of data that can be used for the scientific evaluation of various questions in order to gain or extend knowledge about the suitability, performance and safety of medical devices and treatment methods. Patients are examined at different points in time, all of which correspond to orthopedic routine, and are asked to fill out various questionnaires.
conditions: Presence of a knee joint prosthesis
Complications of internal orthopaedic prosthetic devices, implants and grafts

interventions.name: Patients will be informed about the study prior to the planned knee surgery and will be included with consent. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for primary and/or secondary partial or total endoprosthetics in the knee joint:
- Sled prostheses
- Patellofemoral implants
- Total endoprostheses.
In addition, change/revision operations in the area of the knee joint, if a partial or total endoprosthesis has already been implanted.
Exclusion criteria:
none
